buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Terms and Conditions: A. Eligibility/ Qualifying Criteria 1. The participating firm to be a legal entity and documentary proof of the same to be furnished. 2. Copy of GST and PAN of the firm to be furnished. 3. Bank details of the firm to be attached. 4. Undertaking for having not been blacklisted by any govt dept/ state govt/ PSUs/ SPSUs/ Autonomous bodies to be enclosed. 5. Bidder average turn over certificate to be a minimum of 30% of the bid value or Rs. 14,94,000/- in t he past three years and to be obtained from a CA firm with UDIN. 6. The bidder should have successfully executed at least three (3) similar projects (supply, installation and commissioning of VC/Smart Classroom/AV systems) of value not less than 40% of the estimated tender value in a single order, during the last three (3) financial years, with at least one project invo lving multi-site VC connectivity. Work completion certificate or GeM SDAC to be enclosed. 7. The bidder should be an Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) or an authorized channel partner/s ystem integrator holding valid authorization letters from the OEMs of the major equipment (Interacti ve Display Panel, PTZ Camera, Digital Podium, UPS, NAS) proposed to be supplied, valid for this spe cific tender. Proof of the same must be enclosed. 8. Undertaking for having read all the terms and conditions and shall abide by it to be enclosed. Other Terms & Conditions: 1. Provide printed and soft-copy User Manuals, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Quick Refer ence Guides for each major sub-system, in addition to OEM manuals 2. The bidder shall supply Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) datasheets/catalogues and OEM aut horization certificates for the major equipment (Interactive Panels, PTZ Cameras, Digital Podium, NA S, UPS, Audio Mixers, Wireless Microphones, Amplifiers) preferably along with the bid and prior to su pply.

3. The bidder shall submit a signed Installation and Commissioning Report along with test results for e ach location. 4. Post completion of work contractor shall Handover as-built cabling and connectivity diagrams, equip ment inventory list with serial numbers, and warranty cards/certificates for all supplied equipment. 5. The bidder shall provide a minimum comprehensive on-site warranty of three (3) years from the dat e of successful commissioning for all major active equipment (Interactive Display Panels, OPS, PTZ Cameras, Digital Podium, NAS, UPS, Audio Mixers, Amplifiers, Wireless Microphone Systems) and a minimum of one (1) year for passive items, cables and accessories, unless a longer period is offered by the bidder or mandated by the Department. 6. During the warranty period, the Contractor shall attend to any breakdown/complaint call within 4 wo rking hours of logging the complaint (response time) and resolve the same within 48 hours (resoluti on time). In case a permanent fix is not achievable within this time, a functionally equivalent standb y unit shall be provided until the defective unit is repaired/replaced. 7. The bidder shall not sub-contract the whole or any substantial part of the contract without prior writt en consent of the Department. Installation, integration, testing and commissioning shall be carried o ut by the Contractor's own trained/certified personnel, or personnel deployed by the OEM with the D epartment's concurrence. 8. The bidder will enter into a contractual agreement with the Directorate for the supply of video confe rencing equipment, adhering to the models and specifications sanctioned by the Directorate. 9. Quoted Price should be inclusive of GST. 10. The L1 Bidder shall be determined based on the overall bid submission instead of the bid on each in dividual item. 11. In the event the Seller fails to execute the supply/work, wholly or partly, within the stipulated period , or fails to comply with the terms and conditions of the Contract, or repudiates the Contract, the Bu yer shall, without prejudice to any other rights and remedies available under the Contract, have the right to cancel/terminate the Contract and arrange the undelivered portion from an alternate source at the risk and cost of the Seller. 12. If the cost of procurement from the alternate source is lower than the Contract price, the Seller shall not be entitled to claim the benefit of such reduction. The exercise of this clause shall be without pr ejudice to the Buyer’s right to levy liquidated damages, forfeit the Performance Security, or take an y other action permissible under the GeM terms and applicable rules. 13. The vendor should ensure the following quality checks in the Smart classroom set up: Sl.No Particular Target Latency: 150 ms 1 Quality of Audio & video Packet loss 2% 2 System uptime 99.5% 3 Average Time to Connect 3-5 sec Note: For those terms and conditions not included in the Additional terms & Conditions e.g., LD Charges, F orce Majeure Conditions, etc. the GeM GTC shall prevail. . 3.
